detail.why: L2 (Turkish-speaking) writer, textbook-formal, zero typos, tricolon, greeting and signoff, perfect punctuation. greeting_signoff_frame, terminal_punct_ratio, sentence_initial_caps, politeness_formula and low sentence_len_cv all point LLM at once.
A real project manager email. bold_lead_in_list is the highest-precision structural feature in the catalogue and it fires fully; greeting_signoff_frame fires; the closer is on the LLM lexicon.
A lawyer complaint letter: -maktadır/-mektedir, nominalization, full diacritics, formal signoff. tr_formal_copula and greeting_signoff_frame fire together.

detail.replaces: A4 (Arabic MSA journalist prose — dropped per R22)
detail.why: Replacement trap, same shape as the dropped Arabic row: a careful writer working in the standard register of the genre, with no slang, no typos, no idiom and uniform sentence length. sentence_len_cv, sentence_len_mode_mass and terminal_punct_ratio all point LLM. Standard register carries zero evidence by design.
A support agent snippet. Every phrase is on the LLM strong lexicon and every one of them is literally in a human support snippet library.

A hotel guest on an iPhone with a Turkish keyboard and autocorrect. Perfect diacritics, correct capital İ, correct proper-noun apostrophes, every sentence terminated, sentence-initial capitals. It looks flawless because the keyboard is flawless.

detail.replaces: A7 (Arabic formal MSA chat — dropped per R22)
detail.why: Replacement trap, same shape as the dropped Arabic row: a guest writing formally and correctly to a business, long enough to clear the 20-word gate so it is actually scored. Correct orthography, correct apostrophes, terminal punctuation everywhere, polite closer.

detail.replaces: A8 (Arabic vocalized quotation — dropped per R22)
detail.why: Replacement trap, same shape as the dropped Arabic row: a human review with pasted machine-or-marketing text quoted inside it. The pasted span is not the author style, and the lexicon fires on the quotation rather than on the writer.

Human-written Turkish, machine-translated into English. Flat rhythm, no idioms, no typos, uniform sentence length: sentence_len_cv, sentence_len_mode_mass, paragraph_uniformity and terminal_punct_ratio all point LLM. MT and LLM decoding share a rhythm and this design does not pretend to separate them.

A professional editor writing a review: em dashes, semicolons, an Oxford comma, no typos. Several correlated typographic features fire at once, which is exactly the double-counting failure the joint fit exists to shrink.
Terminal punctuation on every sentence, capitalized, polite, no human markers at all, 16 word tokens. The bottom-left cell of the verdict table: there is no information here.

A human travel blogger writing SEO copy in the format the platform rewards: emoji-headed sections, a bulleted structure, marketing register. Humans copied this format FROM models, which makes marketing the worst confounder class in the catalogue.
Model prompted "reply like a WhatsApp user". tr_asciified_probe, all_lowercase, no terminal punctuation, tr_chat_morphology and human_lexicon (abi) all fire. Every human channel lights up at once.
Three word tokens. Below G2 whatever it looks like.

detail.replaces: B3 (Arabic Levantine dialect on demand — dropped per R22)
detail.why: Replacement trap, same shape as the dropped Arabic row: a model asked for a specific casual register produces it on demand. tr_chat_morphology (napcaz, bakayim), human_lexicon (valla, abi), all_lowercase and absent terminal punctuation all fire. Register is promptable.

Model output post-processed with sed to replace em dashes with commas plus a lowercase pass on sentence openers. em_dash_in_chat, sentence_initial_caps and all_lowercase are neutralized for free; the structural and lexical features must carry it alone. Accept the recall loss, do not compensate by raising weights elsewhere.
Model draft, human rewrote about 30 percent and added two typos. Contradictory evidence in both directions at once.
A model-generated factual answer. There is nothing to measure.

Model output with typos injected by a humanizer tool: teh, recieved, one dropped apostrophe. contraction_apostrophe_drop fires; letter_elongation and self_correction_marker are absent, because humanizers inject character noise, not conversational repair.

Model output written in English and machine-translated into Turkish with full diacritics preserved. It reads like careful human Turkish and the Turkish lexicon misses, because the phrasing arrived through MT rather than from the model directly.
Model given five of the target writer real messages as few-shot examples. The style has been copied from a human; the stylometric signal has been replaced with the victim signal. There is no defence.
Output from a small open-weights model: repetitive, degenerate loop, not GPT-shaped. The strong LLM lexicon misses entirely and content_word_repeat actually points HUMAN.

detail.replaces: B11 (Arabizi on demand — dropped per R22)
detail.why: Replacement trap, same shape as the dropped Arabizi row: a model asked to text like a friend produces letter_elongation, repeated_punct_emoticon and multi_exclam, which are the three highest-precision HUMAN markers in the catalogue, on demand.

Marketing copy generated by a model, then lightly edited by the brand copywriter and published as a review. Hybrid plus marketing register: this row and A12 meeting in the middle is the honest picture of this problem ceiling.
